sqlMap.select: SELECT parcel_no as NUM, parcel_com_code as CODE, buyer || inv_no as FID FROM KEP.kep_parcel WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PARCEL_ID = 'A'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = #flag#, IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER||INV_NO = #fid# AND PARCEL_NO = #num# AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PARCEL_ID = 'A'
UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PARCEL_ID = 'A'
